messages:
Tess Morgan: Opening release notes draft for runtime tweaks (batching presets + KV cache). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6122
Alejandro Cruz: Drop TL;DR so I can edit.
Tess Morgan: TL;DR: new presets (interactive-low-latency, throughput-balanced, cost-saver-1); KV cache: lower mem + better prefix reuse; router prefers same-region; known issue: canary metrics may underreport during warmup.
Alejandro Cruz: I'll add Python + TS snippets and a short migration bullet list.
Tess Morgan: Need a dedicated pool pin example and a tiny ops note about restarting long-lived workers.
Alejandro Cruz: Snippets to paste into the PR:
```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.routes.update('api-checkout', batching_preset='interactive-low-latency')
```
```
// typescript
await client.routes.update('api-checkout', { batchingPreset: 'interactive-low-latency' })
```
QA-bot: Reminder: add whats-new markdown under /docs/whats-new with frontmatter. Suggested frontmatter:
---
date: 2025-07-20
title: "Batching presets + KV cache"
components: [runtime, routing]
---
Alejandro Cruz: Dedicated example for pool config: `poolConfig: { batchingPreset: 'throughput-balanced' }` + note: "Restart or recycle GPU workers to pick up new preset."
Tess Morgan: Known issue wording: "Enabling presets on legacy routes can cause transient p50/p95 spikes for ~1-3 minutes while continuous-batch windows and KV caches rebalance. Canary dashboards may underreport latency during this period." Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-3001
Tess Morgan: Plan: merge after CI + editorial pass. Will ping @eng-oncall at merge for 30m watch. :rocket:
